description: Shrink a scanned PDF from freedailypro to the smallest black-and-white file: JBIG2 symbol mode stores each letter shape once and reuses it across pages, typically 3x smaller than the lossless black-and-white file. Very rarely a letter can be swapped for a look-alike one (for example a 6 and a 8 in tiny print), so check important numbers in the original. Colour and shading are lost and text on converted pages is no longer selectable. A page is converted only when that makes it at least 10% smaller; other pages are copied untouched. Errors if the PDF is unreadable, password-protected, over 100 pages, or if no smaller file results.

fileBase64.description: The PDF, base64 encoded (up to 20 MB, up to 100 pages)

threshold.description: How alike two letter shapes must look to share one stored shape, 0.4 to 0.9. Default 0.85; higher is safer and slightly larger

name: pdf_compress_smallest_bw
